text: 🌺 For as many days as your family keeps Vinayaka at home, you can simply offer the lamp, incense, flowers, naivedyam and harathi each day.
♻️ Flowers, patri and garika — compost them if you can, or put them out as biodegradable wet waste.
🌊 Please do not put them in ponds, canals or rivers because “they are natural anyway”.
Flowers and leaves ARE natural, but in large quantities they take the oxygen out of the water as they decay.
Fish and other water creatures then struggle to breathe, the water quality falls, and the oil, kumkuma, colours and thread that go in with the flowers harm them further.
Eco-friendly does not mean putting natural things into water — it means returning them to the earth without harming her.
🌿 🍎 Fruits, the coconut and the naivedyam — take them as prasadam and share them.
✨ Decorations — keep them for the next puja.
